text:
Sam: FYI Velox Health demo just sporadically started hitting 429s during the embeddings step — happened at 13:07 PT during the walkthrough (lots of documents uploaded).
Maya: Ugh — were they using the batch embeddings endpoint or concurrent requests?
Sam: They uploaded a ~200-doc corpus, our UI chunked it into 8 concurrent batch requests (each ~5k tokens). We saw 429s after ~40s.
Tony: Can you paste the rate-limit headers from one of the failed responses?
Sam: Sure — grabbing from the customer's screenshot: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60000  # tokens/min
X-RateLimit-Reset: 165
Retry-After: 30
Request-ID: rwd-req-9c2f4a
```
Zara: Interesting — the Limit being in tokens/min suggests the per-route cap is token-budgeted (we do that for embeddings routes). 8 concurrent batches * 5k = 40k tokens in flight, plus other background requests could push them over.
Jules: Was this customer's plan supposed to have a higher tokens/min? Sales quoted 120k tokens/min during the POC.
Maya: Checking the tenant config now — one sec.
Maya: Config shows: `per_route_caps: { "embeddings": { "tokens_per_minute": 60000, "requests_per_minute": 1200 } }`  — so tokens cap is 60k, matches the header.
Tony: That explains it. The UI's chunking logic didn't account for the tokens_per_minute cap when running concurrent batches, so bursts exhaust the token budget and subsequent requests get 429s even though requests/pm is fine.
Sam: Customer reports they saw transient 429s but retrying succeeded after ~30s. They want guidance and a short-term fix so the demo doesn't stall.
Zara: Short-term options: 1) temporary tokens_per_minute bump for Velox Health to 150k, 2) advise them to reduce concurrency to 2 simultaneous batches, or 3) enable client-side small-chunking to reduce per-request token size.
Jules: Sales prefers option 1 for the demo window. Can eng apply a temporary override and log the change for billing?
Tony: I can put a safe temporary override in place for the next 6 hours. Command I'll run: 
```
redwood-admin quotas adjust --tenant velox-health --route embeddings --tokens-per-minute 150000 --expires 6h --note "POC demo bump"
```
Maya: Also recommend we add a small guard in the fronting SDK/UI that throttles concurrency when tokens_per_minute utilization > 70% — prevents next-day surprises.
Sam: Good call. For now can you do the override and confirm when in effect? I want to tell the customer it's fixed.
Tony: On it. Applying override now...
deploy-bot: quota-change: tenant=velox-health route=embeddings old=60000 new=150000 by=Tony expires_in=6h note="POC demo bump" request_id=rwd-admin-77b
Tony: Done — change propagated to control plane, regional caches will pick up config within ~20s.
Sam: Confirmed with customer — they retried upload and the backlog cleared, no more 429s. :tada:
Zara: Postmortem action items: 1) Update POC checklist to call out tokens_per_minute vs requests_per_minute behavior for embeddings, 2) Add SDK client-side concurrency guard, 3) Consider automatic short-term emergency bump workflow for Sales-triggered demos.
Jules: I'll log the sales action and include signed approval for the temporary bump in the deal record.
Maya: Also filing a tiny infra ticket to show per-tenant token usage in the demo dashboard (so AE/SE can see utilization live).
Tony: Ticket created: INFRA-4821 "Show per-tenant tokens/min utilization on demo dashboard" — assigned to eng-telemetry.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Customer happy, demo resumed. Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
Zara: One small note — request_id rwd-req-9c2f4a appears in logs as a burst that coincided with a background metric job from their app. We should show them the request footprints.
Sam: I'll relay that and recommend they schedule uploads during non-peak internal jobs.
Jules: Closing loop with sales ops, will archive the approval. :white_check_mark:
